verdict.rationale:
Better Auth documents a plugin that lets an app 'act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource' issuing tokens to external clients, plus a live, reachable MCP-protocol OAuth endpoint confirming the flow works in practice. However, the documented use case is scoped specifically to MCP clients rather than a generic 'Sign in with my app' OAuth provider for arbitrary third-party apps (unlike the SSO plugin, which is for consuming external IdPs, not acting as one).

missing for 10: a generic/standalone OAuth-provider plugin documented for arbitrary third-party client registration and consent flows, independent developer reports of building a general-purpose OAuth provider (not just MCP) with Better Auth.
